name: Leather Belt
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Made from high-quality PU leather, offering durability and a classic, stylish look.

- Smooth surface with fine craftsmanship ensures long-lasting use.

- Sturdy metal buckle provides secure fastening and a polished finish.

- Available in two versatile colors: Brown and Black.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

- Belt width: 1.45 in ~ 3.7 cm.

- Available lengths:
+) 39.37 in ~ 100 cm.
+) 43.31 in ~ 110 cm.
+) 47.24 in ~ 120 cm.
+) 51.18 in ~ 130 cm.
+) 59.05 in ~ 150 cm.
 

  • Sizing Guide:

- Belt size is measured from the buckle to the most commonly used hole.

- It is recommended to choose a belt size about 2 inches larger than your pants size.

Example: If you wear size 32 pants, choose a size 34 belt for the best fit.

 

  • Customization:

- Can be personalized with names, initials, or custom designs.

- A great way to create a unique and personal accessory.

 

  • Printing Technology:

- Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting designs.

- High-definition printing ensures colors remain clear and resistant to fading over time.

- Provides a clean and precise finish that enhances the overall appearance.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

- Designed for everyday wear with both casual and formal outfits.

- Adjustable holes provide a comfortable and secure fit.

- Easy to pair with jeans, trousers, or business attire.

- A practical accessory that combines style and functionality.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- A timeless and practical gift for men.

- Ideal for birthdays, Father’s Day, anniversaries, or special occasions.

- Combines personalization with everyday usefulness, making it a thoughtful choice.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Leather Belt

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
